parsed.reason: Description A says the retry loop catches all GatewayError, including permanent errors like CardDeclined, so declines are retried needlessly. Description B says that after retries are exhausted the function breaks and falls through, returning None instead of raising, which later causes AttributeError. These are different failures: one concerns retrying non-transient errors, the other the missing raise/return on exhaustion.
